facts.name: Visa
sentences: Visa's shares moved 5% or more on 2 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 29 April 2026, when the stock rose 8.3%.
The stock is up 24.5% this year, and at $436.57 it sits 0.0% below its 52-week closing high of $436.57 from 4 November 2026.
$1,000 invested in Visa five years ago would be worth $2,091 today.
